snippet.title: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://bit.ly/4zfGW5f

Some problems can only be solved with a bullet—
NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is a TPS action horror about hunting Yokai in fast-paced combat by executing weapon-switching commands.
In the Yokai-infested near-future Tokyo Ruins, play as Misha (voiced by Miyuki Sawashiro), Public Safety's top Operator, and unveil the mystery behind the nightmare caused by the militant separatists Tasogare-no-Yaiba.
